metadata.project_title: Real-Time Transmission Line Fault Detection and Classification using an Artificial Neural Network
metadata.department: Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering, NIT Puducherry

baseline.name: Baseline ANN (32-16 MLP, 6 Classes)
baseline.description: Multilayer Perceptron with 2 hidden layers (32, 16 neurons) and ReLU activations.

enhanced.name: Enhanced Deep ANN (64-32 MLP, 6 Classes)
enhanced.description: Optimized wider MLP with adaptive learning rate for sharper decision boundaries.

protective_standard.name: IEEE Standard Protection ANN (5 Classes)
protective_standard.description: Classifies faults into standard relay operating zones (LG, LL, LLG, 3-Phase Symmetrical, Healthy). Resolves symmetrical neutral current cancellation.

conductor_heads.name: Multi-Output Conductor Identification ANN
conductor_heads.description: Directly predicts Ground (G), Phase C, Phase B, and Phase A fault involvement.

physical_insights.LG (A-G): Phase A current spikes sharply (up to 8x nominal), Phase A voltage drops near zero. High zero-sequence ground current Ig = Ia + Ib + Ic.
physical_insights.LL (B-C): Equal and opposite surge currents in Phase B and Phase C (Ib ≈ -Ic). Phase A remains healthy. Ground current Ig ≈ 0.
physical_insights.LLG (A-B-G): Severe current surge in both Phase A and Phase B accompanied by high ground fault current Ig. Phase C remains normal.
physical_insights.LLL (A-B-C): Symmetrical 3-phase short circuit. Massive current surges across all 3 phases (120° apart). Phase voltages collapse towards zero. Because currents are balanced, sum Ia + Ib + Ic ≈ 0.
physical_insights.LLLG (A-B-C-G): Symmetrical 3-phase fault with ground connection. Due to 3-phase electrical symmetry, the neutral potential remains at zero volts; hence ground current remains near zero, identical to LLL.
physical_insights.No Fault: Balanced 3-phase currents and sinusoidal voltages with 120° phase displacement. Current magnitude within rated continuous threshold.
